;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis]] expands the [[Secretariat for Communications]] and appoints 13 new consultants in addition to the 16 members added on July 13, 2016. The secretariat was established in June 2015. [https://www.americamagazine.org/faith/2017/04/12/father-james-martin-appointed-pope-francis-vatican-department-communications (''America Magazine'')]

;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Ten people are killed in [[Inabanga, Bohol]], in the Philippines' [[Central Visayas]], after the country's [[Philippine National Police|National Police]] and [[Armed Forces of the Philippines|Armed Forces]] [[2017 Bohol clash|clash]] with suspected members of [[Abu Sayyaf]]. [http://cnnphilippines.com/news/2017/04/11/Abu-Sayyaf-firefight-Bohol.html (CNN Philippines)]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**A suicide bomber kills at least five people and injures ten more near government offices in [[Kabul]]. [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility for the attack. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/04/suicide-bomb-attack-heart-kabul-kills-170412132809450.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economics
*[[History of the United States dollar]]
**In an interview, [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] says the [[United States dollar|U.S. dollar]] is "getting too strong" and wants to keep interest rates low, causing the [[U.S. Dollar Index]] to fall. [http://uk.reuters.com/article/us-global-forex-idUKKBN17C027 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Sheila Abdus-Salaam]], an incumbent associate judge of the [[New York Court of Appeals]] and the first African-American woman to serve on the Court of Appeals is found dead in the [[Hudson River]]. [http://www.ny1.com/nyc/all-boroughs/news/2017/04/12/court-of-appeals-judge-found-dead-in-hudson-river.html (NY1 News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Iranian presidential election, 2017]]
**Former [[President of Iran|Iranian President]] [[Mahmoud Ahmadinejad]] registers to run in next month's election for a non-consecutive third term, according to state media. [https://www.rferl.org/a/ahmadinejad-registers-iranian-president/28425030.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]
*[[Protests in South Africa]]
**[[Julius Malema]] addresses a large, multi-racial crowd in Pretoria before their march on the Union buildings. [https://web.archive.org/web/20170413234807/https://weeklyxpose.co.za/2017/04/12/malema-warned-marchers-behave/ (Weekly Xpose South Africa)]
